title: Steady Climb
briefing: Orchard Foods is climbing slowly and steadily. Panic Pete is watching the headlines, ready to run at the first scary one.
objective: Hold a good trend through a scary headline instead of selling the dip.
debrief: Orchard Foods climbed most days. The "overvalued" call on day 10 knocked it down for a day or two, and Panic Pete sold into the dip, then bought back higher once the climb resumed. The trend never broke. A disciplined player bought early and held through the noise.

assets.name: Orchard Foods
assets.blurb: Runs a chain of neighborhood grocery stores.

news.headline: Analyst calls Orchard Foods "overvalued"
news.body: The analyst says the shares have risen faster than profits this year.

basic.text: Finish with more profit than your opponent

bonus.text: Be invested by day 5 and stay invested through day 25
Do not sell on the scary headline: hold from day 9 to day 13
